about.metaDescription: AGRO IBO is a domestic company founded in Kyrgyzstan. HYDROWOOLKS next-generation organic fertilizers.
about.title: AGRO IBO — a domestic company developing agriculture in Kyrgyzstan
about.subtitle: Our main goal is to increase crop yields and preserve soil fertility by offering farmers high-quality, ecologically safe, and highly effective organic fertilizers.

brand.name: HYDROWOOLKS
brand.description: A liquid organic fertilizer obtained through a special technology of hydrolyzing sheep's wool. Production is carried out in Kyrgyzstan, and the product is suitable for use on all types of agricultural crops.

mission.text: To bring organic products manufactured in Kyrgyzstan to the global market, increase farmers' income, reduce dependence on chemical fertilizers, and preserve fertile, clean soil for future generations.
mission.note: Today, AGRO IBO cooperates with farmers across various regions of Kyrgyzstan and is actively working towards entering the international market, offering modern, effective and environmentally safe agricultural solutions.
